name: Cantoni Digital Studio voice style reference
rules: Use only clips where Emanuele is the only speaker.
Use only WhatsApp clips sent by Emanuele, filtered from local metadata with ZISFROMME=1.
Do not store voice clips in git.
Do not upload clips to external voice providers without explicit approval.
Do not publish synthetic or cloned voice without final review.
Do not use clips containing private client data, passwords, payments, health, legal or personal material.

style_profile.pacing: medio, con pause brevi dopo punti importanti
style_profile.language: semplice, comprensibile a clienti non tecnici
